ideas.hook: A full round disc sitting low in the deep notch of a single broad V, like the sun settled into a valley
ideas.means: Sun + vale: the name drawn literally, the sun held by the land

review.reading: a ball resting in a broad V; risk down-chevron with dot or ice-cream cone if the V is thin

ideas.hook: A roof pitch turned upside down so the roof becomes a cradle, holding a warm disc in its fold
ideas.means: The roofs we share hold our sun; the roof as something that carries, not covers

review.reading: a down chevron/V holding a dot - same drawing as i1, the roof is invisible

ideas.hook: One big disc assembled from several smaller discs of different sizes packed tightly together, no gaps on the outline
ideas.means: Many neighbours' shares make one sun; one member, one vote

review.reading: a round pebble-packed disc of many dots, like a seed head or bubbles; risk grapes/cells

ideas.hook: A row of three low, differently pitched roof slopes seen edge-on, each lit along its top edge in warm colour
ideas.means: The school, the library and the warehouse: real local roofs side by side

review.reading: a factory sawtooth roof / row of house roofs

ideas.hook: A folded ballot slip half-way into a round slot that is itself a sun-coloured disc
ideas.means: Your vote goes into the sun you own

review.reading: a ballot-box / voting icon - the product's own object

ideas.hook: Two rounded shoulders leaning toward each other with a warm disc held between them, like two neighbours carrying something together
ideas.means: Co-ownership as a shared carry between neighbours

review.reading: two figures holding a ball - community/teamwork clip art

ideas.hook: Lowercase wordmark 'sunvale' in which the v is drawn as a wide soft valley and a solid round dot rests in its crook instead of above any letter
ideas.means: The vale in the name literally holds the sun; the word carries the idea

review.reading: the word sunvale with a solid dot sitting in a wide soft v - a ball cradled in the word

ideas.hook: A wordmark where the u of 'sun' and the v of 'vale' are drawn as the same cupped shape, one rounded and one pointed, like a sunrise bowl and a valley
ideas.means: Sun and vale rhyme visually inside the word

review.reading: a plain sunvale wordmark - the u/v rhyme has no visible form at 32 px

ideas.hook: A disc cut into horizontal bands that step down at the bottom like terraced fields in a valley
ideas.means: Sunlight falling on a shaped, cultivated local landscape

review.reading: a striped retro synthwave sunset - cliche

ideas.hook: A patchwork quilt square of four warm patches of slightly different sizes, stitched with visible gaps
ideas.means: A neighbourhood stitched together from many small contributions

review.reading: four-pane square - the Microsoft Windows logo

ideas.hook: A half-risen disc whose lower edge is a gently wavy horizon made of rooftops' rhythm, not houses — just an undulating line
ideas.means: Morning over our town

review.reading: sun rising over wavy hills - category cliche

ideas.hook: Concentric arcs spreading outward from one small solid disc, like ripples in a pond from a dropped pebble
ideas.means: One roof's energy spreading into the neighbourhood and to households in need

review.reading: wifi / broadcast signal icon

ideas.hook: A round disc with a single wedge-shaped share cut out and lifted slightly away, like one slice of a cake handed to you
ideas.means: Your share of the sun, handed over

review.reading: pie chart / Pac-Man

ideas.hook: A warm serif lowercase 's' whose upper bowl is a filled sun disc and lower bowl an open valley curve
ideas.means: Sun above, vale below, in the initial

review.reading: a lowercase s with a solid upper bowl - an s holding a ball

ideas.hook: A two-line stacked wordmark 'sun' over 'vale' in a heavy rounded face where the right stem of the n and the left arm of the v are one shared stroke, so the two words lock together into one block
ideas.means: Two halves of the name, like neighbours, literally share a part; co-ownership drawn in the type

review.reading: a stacked two-line text block; the shared n/v stroke spans two lines and is invisible at 32 px, and dies at 16 px

ideas.hook: A half-disc standing on its flat edge, split by two vertical gaps into three slices of clearly different widths — a sun made of shares on one shared horizon
ideas.means: Different households' shares together make one rising sun; the flat edge is the common ground

review.reading: a sliced setting sun on a horizon - the striped-sunset cliche turned vertical; also a bar chart in a dome

ideas.hook: Lowercase 'sunvale' in a heavy soft face where the u is drawn as a solid warm half-disc, flat side up, like a sun sinking into the word
ideas.means: The sun settles into the vale inside the name itself; no dot, no extra element

review.reading: the word sunvale whose u is a solid warm half-bowl - a sun sunk into the word; risks: reads as one swapped letter in a stock sans (scored 5 last round) or a smile; needs a drawn face and the bowl must still read as u

ideas.hook: A disc formed by two thick C-shaped halves of different weights hooking into each other at top and bottom, like two hands clasped around a shared warm centre
ideas.means: Two neighbours holding one thing together; the sun is the space they share

review.reading: two interlocking C hooks - a sync/refresh loop or chain-link icon

ideas.hook: A wordmark in a warm, sturdy lowercase whose every round counter (u, n, a, e) is the same tall arched opening, like the row of arched windows on a town library or school
ideas.means: The co-op lives on civic roofs everyone knows; one treatment through every letter

review.reading: a plain sturdy lowercase wordmark; arched counters are a typeface trait, the library-window meaning has no visible form

ideas.hook: A thick ring whose band swells smoothly from hairline at the bottom to very heavy at the top, like a day's sunlight curve wrapped into a circle
ideas.means: Live production of every roof: the daily arc of light, owned and watched

review.reading: a thick ring heavy at the top thinning to a hairline at the bottom - a weighted O, sun riding high; risks: inverted crescent/eclipse or loading spinner if the swell is too even
